facility.name: Bais Menachem
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,After School Care,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 3500 HYRIDGE DR, AUSTIN, TX, 78759

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912): 2912 affidavits were not available for review for an employee.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.1105(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver did not have an elligibile or, provisional background clearence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: A current employee list was not posted
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: A health statemnt was not available for an enrolled child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: a potential employee was observing in a classroom prior to obtaining and eligible background result. An administrative penalty is recommended for this violation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: A current fire inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Two classrooms had shaving cream accessible to children. The children use the shaving cream for sensory play. The shaving cream manufacturer instructions state that it must be kept out of reach of children. This was corrected when the director removed the shaving cream from the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers did not know the number of children they were responsible for. This was corrected when the caregivers verified how many children were in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Definition- What does Licensing mean by the term ?use zone??: At inspection, there were numerous items, blocking the exit of the playground slide.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Definition- What does Licensing mean by the term ?use zone?? (26 TAC §746.4801)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Classroom two, a 16 month-old child was found asleep in a stroller.  At inspection, the child was removed from the stroller and placed on a naptime mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: At inspection, the outdoor play area had a slide that did not have the required use zone between the slide and the fence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During transitions from inside to outside, children in three classrooms were observed running from the classroom to the playground and around a building without the caregiver in close proximity to maintain visual or auditory awareness.     The school aged children were observed playing inside an outdoor storage shed, with the doors closed, but top open, limiting the caregivers' ability to supervise.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current sanitation inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At inspection, two caregivers were not aware of the exact number of children they were caring for.  This was corrected when the caregivers verified how many children were in their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room: During the inspection, none of the classrooms had an evalcuation plan, posted.  The director put evacuation plans in all of the classrooms at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: During inspection, two classes were found to have cleaning supplies within reach of the children.  This was corrected at inspection when the cleaning supplies were moved to a secure location.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have training in food allergies, hazardous materials, and SIDS/shaken baby syndrome.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: At inspection, the outdoor playground area did not have six inches of required loose fill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Three caregivers did not have training in food allergies and hazardous materials.  One caregiver did not have training in SIDS/shaken baby syndrome.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: Garbage in two classrooms were accessible to children.  The garbage cans were covered up during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: In classroom number two, two children ages 17-18 months were sitting in high chairs without safety straps secured.  This was corrected when the seat straps were secured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: A current fire inspection was not available for review
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Three outlet covers in three rooms were accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Annual trainings for all four caregivers of children 5 and under had not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: Operation has not conducted any severe weather or lockdown drills this school year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One caregiver was present at the operation who did not have a current eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the younger toddler room there is exposed wiring near the bathroom.  In the young toddler bathroom and older toddler bathroom there is exposed wiring near the ceiling.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center has not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by Feburary 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: One person was present counted in ratio with children who does not have a background check.     This person was asked to leave during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation: The operational policies were missing preventing/reporting abuse and neglect, contact information for CCR, the HHS website and reviewing the minimum standards and past inspection forms.     This was corrected when the policies were written and added to the handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(21))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: One child is still missing immunizations and a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation: The operational policies were missing preventing/reporting abuse and neglect, contact information for CCR, the HHS website and reviewing the minimum standards and past inspection forms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parent Participation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(21))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: The operation did not have their emergency drill log and the playground maintenance checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: Upon arrival at the operation a group of children ages 10-11 walked out of their classroom into the courtyard area without a caregiver for 2 minutes. The caregiver was in the classroom with another child. The caregiver left the classroom to supervise the children in the courtyard but left one child unattended in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Out of eight staff files reviewed one was missing proof of education. One was missing an affidavit. One file was incomplete missing photo identification, an affidavit, proof of education, CPR and first aid certification and proof of background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center: Lesson plans for each age group were not posted. The emergency telephone numbers were not posted either.     The emergency telephone numbers were corrected when the operation posted them during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Activity Plans for each group of children in the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: All four caregivers had to count how many children they were in charge of when asked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: Two out of eight children were missing health statements. One out of eight files was missing immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission (26 TAC §746.611(b))
